subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR land the legacy no-code diagnostic runtime invalidation after updated proof/rebase, or should legacy cleanup move to doctor/migration instead?
rationale: The explicit marker follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy no-code branch intentionally changes upgraded persisted-state behavior and current main has adjacent load-path registry changes that need owner acceptance.

options.title: Require Proof And Rebase Refresh
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal/log/live output showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and startup proceeds, then re-review against current main's load-path registry logic.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can accept the regression tests and source inspection as enough, but that waives external real-behavior proof for upgraded persisted state.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Pause this PR's runtime legacy fallback and handle old no-code diagnostics through migration or doctor-owned cleanup instead.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Rebase Refresh
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal/log/live output showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and startup proceeds, then re-review against current main's load-path registry logic.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and have recent ownership signal in the same plugin registry path.
